business_problem: MTP needed to speed up security research, compliance analysis, and software validation for regulated clients without exposing confidential customer data or overwhelming engineers with repetitive manual work.
solution_summary: MTP rolled out Gemini Enterprise as a governed research and engineering platform for its 650-person digital assurance business. The company built shared prompt libraries, workshops, and a routing layer on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform so everyday tasks go to Gemini Flash while complex programming logic goes to Gemini Pro. Deep Research and custom no-code research agents shorten cybersecurity and regulatory analysis, and Gemini Notebook helps teams extract compliance insights faster from large bodies of technical material. The company also connects these AI tools to internal SharePoint compliance manuals so analysts can ask plain-language questions and verify whether client software meets specific standards. To protect sensitive banking and public-sector workloads, MTP runs the platform on European endpoints and uses Model Armor to block prompt injection and data leakage, while Gemini Code Assist is extending the same model into secure coding and documentation workflows.

data_flow: Technical documents, regulations, and internal manuals are queried through Gemini Enterprise and routed to the appropriate Gemini model, with research agents and notebooks synthesizing findings, SharePoint-connected knowledge answering compliance questions, and Model Armor enforcing safety controls around sensitive client data.
business_outcome: MTP saves roughly two hours per person per day, cut six-hour research tasks to two hours, reduced compliance-search time by 40%, and improved documentation speed by 35% while keeping regulated client data isolated on trusted European endpoints.
